principle: Changes mark dependent artifacts/checks dirty; they do not automatically execute every downstream pass. Preserve valid accepted work and rerun the smallest owner scope. Read-only final checks always rerun after accepted edits before readiness.

events.change: selected title, thumbnail, shared curiosity question or promised payoff
rerun: draft sections that no longer deliver promise
events.preserve: Unchanged valid prose; do not regenerate entire script merely because wording of title changes.

events.change: brief, main point, audience or major order
recheck: all promises, signposts, callbacks, placements and final_flow

events.change: teaching fact, framework count or example
recheck: hook and Parker promises referencing change
global signpost ratio, adjacency, Parker counts

events.change: magnet selected, removed or facts changed
rerun: lead_magnets only; update structure slots without rebuilding body
claim owner hook or signposts on exact spans
reject stale patches, refresh actual affected span/context; re-propose only necessary pass

recheck: all artifacts linked to changed rule ID; route failures to owner
